subject: PO exemption pathway for BlueHorizon Labs onboarding
messages:
From: Emma Soto <emma.soto@bluehorizon.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@bluehorizon.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question on onboarding — PO timing

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at BlueHorizon is excited about the latency and cost profile you showed. We're ready to spin up the pilot but procurement just flagged that our PO process can take 4–6 weeks. For a small pilot (estimated spend ~$6k over 30 days) procurement asked whether Redwood will accept onboarding and invoice-only billing (no PO) for the initial pilot period, or whether a PO is strictly required before provisioning.

If invoice-only is possible, what controls do you need from our side (W-9, vendor forms, signed MSA addendum)? Would Redwood be able to issue standard Net 30 invoices for this pilot? I attached our completed onboarding form for your intake team.

Attachments: bluehorizon_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Emma Soto
Director, Platform Partnerships
BlueHorizon Labs
emma.soto@bluehorizon.ai
+1 (415) 555-0122

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Emma Soto <emma.soto@bluehorizon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on onboarding — PO timing

Thanks, Emma — got the form. Looping in procurement and sales.

Short answer: we have a formal PO-required policy for production commitments, but we frequently approve short pilots on an invoice-only path under a set of controls. To evaluate, procurement/legal will need:
- Completed onboarding form (received)
- W-9 / vendor tax info
- SOC 2 report or attestation if you plan to send sensitive data
- Signed pilot addendum or e-sign MSA amendment covering data handling and liability limits

Jonas — can procurement do a quick vendor risk check and approve an invoice-only pilot up to $10k for 60 days if BlueHorizon provides W-9 + SOC2 attestation and we get the signed addendum? If you need a purchase threshold or additional controls, please advise.

Emma — if it's helpful Marissa can propose the pilot billing cadence and the DocuSign addendum we typically use.

[Attachment: redwood_onboarding_checklist.txt]

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Head of Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Emma Soto <emma.soto@bluehorizon.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on onboarding — PO timing

+1 to a short pilot exception here. From a sales POV: BlueHorizon is a high-propensity account and letting them begin quickly will materially increase chance of expansion. Suggested guardrails:
- Pilot cap $10k total, auto-suspend if invoice aging > 15 days
- Require e-signed addendum + PO or formal MSA to move to any production spend > $10k
- Finance can require a credit card on file for immediate cutover if needed

Rafael — if procurement signs off, I'm happy to run the DocuSign through with BlueHorizon today and commit to monitoring invoice aging.

Marissa
Sr. Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Emma Soto <emma.soto@bluehorizon.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on onboarding — PO timing

Thanks for the context. Procurement is open to a controlled exception but we need documented criteria and an approval trail. I'll need the following before I sign off on an invoice-only pilot:
1) Completed vendor intake (W-9 + banking remittance) — can BlueHorizon provide?
2) Evidence of SOC 2 Type II or attestation (if pilot will process customer PII)
3) Completed internal exception_request_form.xlsx (I attached a one-page form) with justification, expected spend, and named owner for invoice aging.

Operational constraints we propose: approved for 60 days, maximum cumulative invoice amount $10,000, Finance to review actual aging weekly, automatic hold if invoices > 15 days past due. Legal to approve the addendum for liability cap (we recommend $10k for pilot). If all satisfied, procurement signs the exception and Finance creates a short-term vendor record.

[Attachment: exception_request_form.xlsx (xlsx)]

If you want, Rafael, I can take the draft justification and fill the form. We will need Vanessa (billing ops) to create the short-term vendor record and pick the invoicing cadence.

Jonas
Sr. Procurement Manager
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Emma Soto <emma.soto@bluehorizon.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: BlueHorizon short pilot — conditional no-PO exception

This thread is to document approval for a temporary invoice-only pilot for BlueHorizon Labs (deal BH-2026-PILOT-47). Conditions below — procurement + finance approved and legal signed the addendum via DocuSign:

Conditions of approval (effective immediately):
- Pilot window: 2026-06-17 through 2026-08-16 (60 days)
- Maximum cumulative invoiced amount: $10,000
- Required vendor evidence (received): W-9, completed onboarding form, SOC 2 attestation (received 2026-06-16)
- Signed addendum: redwood-addendum-BH-docusign.pdf (DocuSign completed)
- Billing terms: Net 30 invoices issued monthly; Finance will monitor aging weekly and notify Rafael/Marissa at 10 days past due
- Automatic suspension: account will be suspended for provisioning if any invoice goes >15 days overdue until resolution or PO is provided

Vanessa — please create short-term vendor record and set invoice routing to FinancePayments@redwood.com. Marissa/Emma — please confirm DocuSign copy; I'll attach final signed addendum for the record.

[Attachment: redwood-addendum-BH-docusign.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks everyone — Rafael
